system.description:
Bee Husbandry is named in the Roden Beekeeper lifepath (Burning Wheel Codex) but has no entry of its own; it uses the Animal Husbandry entry.

Animal Husbandry involves the raising, care and breeding of animals.

Obstacles: Chickens, Ob 1. Pigs and goats, Ob 2. Cows and horses, Ob 3. Exotic animals, Ob 4. Tending to wounds and illness, use the Field Dressing or Apothecary skill obstacles.

Skill Type: Peasant. Tools: Yes.

Root: Will

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 255
